// ShouldSwitchPT reports whether an affected card's power and toughness are
// switched (Rule 613.4e, Layer 7e). Scoping goes through the same
// effectAffectsCard matching every other layer uses. Each applicable switch
// effect swaps the pair once, so an even number of them cancels out and only
// an odd count actually switches.
func (m *EffectManager) ShouldSwitchPT(card *Card, sourceControllerIdx int) bool {
	m.mu.RLock()
	defer m.mu.RUnlock()

	n := 0
	for _, e := range m.effects {
		if e.SwitchPT && m.effectAffectsCard(e, card, sourceControllerIdx) {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n%2 == 1
}

// GetPowerWithEffects returns effective power including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters)
func (c *Card) GetPowerWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BasePower but obtain a set
	// power via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BasePower == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}

	base := 0
	if c.BasePower != nil {
		base = *c.BasePower
	}

	if em == nil {
		return base + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
	}

	// Check if any effect sets power to a specific value (Layer 7b)
	if setPower := em.GetSetPower(c, c.Controller); setPower != nil {
		return *setPower + em.GetPowerBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
	}
	// Normal case: base + bonuses (Layer 7c)
	return base + em.GetPowerBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
}

// GetToughnessWithEffects returns effective toughness including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters)
func (c *Card) GetToughnessWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BaseToughness but obtain a
	// set toughness via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BaseToughness == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}

	base := 0
	if c.BaseToughness != nil {
		base = *c.BaseToughness
	}

	if em == nil {
		return base + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
	}

	// Check if any effect sets toughness to a specific value (Layer 7b)
	if setToughness := em.GetSetToughness(c, c.Controller); setToughness != nil {
		return *setToughness + em.GetToughnessBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
	}
	// Normal case: base + bonuses (Layer 7c)
	return base + em.GetToughnessBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
}

// ptWithEffects computes effective power AND toughness as one pair, in layer
// order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters), then 7e (switch
// P/T). Both public getters below read this single result, so they can never
// disagree about which pair of post-layer values is current, and neither has
// to call the other (a switch needs both halves, and mutual getter calls
// would recurse forever).
func (c *Card) ptWithEffects(em *EffectManager) (int, int) {
	power, toughness := 0, 0
	if c.BasePower != nil {
		power = *c.BasePower
	}
	if c.BaseToughness != nil {
		toughness = *c.BaseToughness
	}

	if em == nil {
		return power + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier(),
			toughness + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()
	}

	// Layer 7b: effects that set P/T to a specific value replace the base.
	if setPower := em.GetSetPower(c, c.Controller); setPower != nil {
		power = *setPower
	}
	if setToughness := em.GetSetToughness(c, c.Controller); setToughness != nil {
		toughness = *setToughness
	}
	// Layers 7c (bonuses) and 7d (counters).
	power += em.GetPowerBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetPowerModifier()
	toughness += em.GetToughnessBonus(c, c.Controller) + c.Counters.GetToughnessModifier()

	// Layer 7e: switch last, on the fully modified values (Rule 613.4e) — a
	// 2/5 with +1/+2 is 3/7 here and becomes 7/3, not 5/2 or 8/5.
	if em.ShouldSwitchPT(c, c.Controller) {
		power, toughness = toughness, power
	}
	return power, toughness
}

// GetPowerWithEffects returns effective power including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters), 7e (switch P/T)
func (c *Card) GetPowerWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BasePower but obtain a set
	// power via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BasePower == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}

	power, _ := c.ptWithEffects(em)
	return power
}

// GetToughnessWithEffects returns effective toughness including all continuous effects
// Layer order: 7b (set P/T), 7c (+N/+N effects), 7d (counters), 7e (switch P/T)
func (c *Card) GetToughnessWithEffects(em *EffectManager) int {
	// Animated non-creatures (manlands) have nil BaseToughness but obtain a
	// set toughness via a ContinuousEffect. Skip the nil-guard so Layer 7b applies.
	if c.BaseToughness == nil && !c.AnimatedAsCreature {
		return 0
	}

	_, toughness := c.ptWithEffects(em)
	return toughness
}

package game

// ticket:engine.pt-switch-layer — Layer 7e P/T switch (Rule 613.4e).
//
// These are discriminating tests, not smoke tests: an implementation that
// snapshots current P/T into SetPower/SetToughness (Layer 7b) passes an
// unmodified 2/5 creature but reports 8/5 for the 2/5 + (+1/+2) case, where
// the correct post-additive answer is 7/3. Every case below carries a live
// Layer 7c bonus for exactly that reason.

import "testing"

// pt is a helper so both getters are always read together — they must agree
// on one pair of post-layer values.
func pt(c *Card, em *EffectManager) (int, int) {
	return c.GetPowerWithEffects(em), c.GetToughnessWithEffects(em)
}

// A 2/5 with +1/+2 is 3/7 before the switch and must be 7/3 after it.
func TestSwitchPTPostAdditiveBonus(t *testing.T) {
	em := NewEffectManager()
	c := NewCreature("Switch Test Ogre", ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 0)

	em.Register(&ContinuousEffect{Source: c, PowerMod: 1, ToughnessMod: 2})
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 3 || tough != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("Layer 7c baseline: want 3/7, got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}

	sw := &ContinuousEffect{Source: c, SwitchPT: true, UntilEOT: true}
	em.Register(sw)
	if sw.Layer != "7e" {
		t.Fatalf("default layer for a switch effect: want %q, got %q", "7e", sw.Layer)
	}
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 7 || tough != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("post-additive switch: want 7/3 (8/5 = 7b snapshot, 5/2 = pre-bonus swap), got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}
	// The switch must not masquerade as a Layer 7b setter.
	if em.GetSetPower(c, c.Controller) != nil || em.GetSetToughness(c, c.Controller) != nil {
		t.Fatalf("switch effect must not register Layer 7b set power/toughness")
	}

	// UntilEOT cleanup restores the unswitched values.
	em.RemoveUntilEOT()
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 3 || tough != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("after UntilEOT cleanup: want 3/7, got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}
}

// Two simultaneous switches cancel; removing one re-switches, removing both
// restores the original orientation.
func TestSwitchPTTwoSwitchesCancel(t *testing.T) {
	em := NewEffectManager()
	c := NewCreature("Switch Test Drake", ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 0)
	em.Register(&ContinuousEffect{Source: c, PowerMod: 1, ToughnessMod: 2})

	first := &ContinuousEffect{Source: c, SwitchPT: true}
	second := &ContinuousEffect{Source: c, SwitchPT: true}
	em.Register(first)
	em.Register(second)
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 3 || tough != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("two switches must cancel: want 3/7, got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}

	em.RemoveByID(second.ID)
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 7 || tough != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("one remaining switch: want 7/3, got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}

	em.RemoveByID(first.ID)
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 3 || tough != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("after removing both switches: want 3/7, got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}
}

// The switch applies on top of a Layer 7b setter plus a Layer 7c bonus:
// 2/5 base, set 4/1, +1/+2 -> 5/3 -> switched 3/5. Existing 7b/7c behavior is
// unchanged while no switch is registered.
func TestSwitchPTAppliesAfterSetPT(t *testing.T) {
	em := NewEffectManager()
	c := NewCreature("Switch Test Golem", ManaCost{}, 2, 5, 0)

	setP, setT := 4, 1
	em.Register(&ContinuousEffect{Source: c, SetPower: &setP, SetToughness: &setT})
	em.Register(&ContinuousEffect{Source: c, PowerMod: 1, ToughnessMod: 2})
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 5 || tough != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("Layer 7b+7c baseline (unchanged behavior): want 5/3, got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}

	em.Register(&ContinuousEffect{Source: c, SwitchPT: true})
	if p, tough := pt(c, em); p != 3 || tough != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("switch after 7b+7c: want 3/5, got %d/%d", p, tough)
	}
}
>>>END

EXPECT: A ContinuousEffect with SwitchPT:true now defaults to Layer 7e and makes both Card getters report a single post-7d swapped P/T pair (2/5 with +1/+2 reads 7/3), with paired switches cancelling and removal/UntilEOT cleanup restoring the unswitched values; TestSwitchPT* in backend/game/switch_pt_layer_test.go covers it.
